summary: A focused Follow system Switch that the Omarchy card disables keeps focus, ignores Space and Enter, leaves the Switch and the saved preferences unchanged, and Tab moves on to the card
limitations: keyboard and AT-SPI only on Linux X11 at scale factor 1 and 13 pt; the other five controls and the Button are covered by the view test; macOS, native Wayland, fractional scale factors and a screen reader speaking are not covered

# Disabled focus fixture

Disposable QA repository.

steps.note: Tab 6 is Back to repository, Tab 7 the Follow system Switch (#124's order)
the Switch draws no focus ring, so the frame equals Settings with nothing focused; a visible ring means the count went astray
AT-SPI's focused node with the Switch focused and enabled
focus is on Follow system appearance before the card is clicked

steps.shows: Settings on Midnight with keyboard focus on the Follow system Switch, which draws no ring; AT-SPI names the focused node

steps.note: the store before the card click
select the Omarchy card with the pointer, so the Switch turns disabled while it holds focus
the palette changed to Omarchy Tokyo Night
the store once the click's save has settled

steps.shows: the Omarchy card selected by the pointer: Tokyo Night applied, the Follow system Switch disabled and still holding keyboard focus

steps.note: focus after the click, before Space and Enter
Space on the focused disabled Switch; its logged first change should be none
Enter on the focused disabled Switch; its logged first change should be none

steps.shows: after Space and Enter on the focused disabled Switch: the Switch, the card and the palette unchanged

steps.note: the store after Space and Enter
park before the keyboard input: the capture after Tab keeps the pointer off the window, so GPUI stays in keyboard mode and nothing is hovered
Tab leaves the disabled Switch for the Omarchy card

steps.shows: Tab leaves the Switch: keyboard focus on the Omarchy card, drawn with its whole 2 px ring outside the selected border; AT-SPI agrees
